title: mail/set: hardcoded Date header in create_one_email
description: In crates/mail/src/email/set.rs create_one_email(), the Date header is hardcoded to 'Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:00 +0000'. All articles created via JMAP Email/set will have the wrong date, breaking newsreader sorting, threading, and RFC 5322 conformance. The timestamp variable is already computed (as ms since epoch) for the Message-ID — it must be formatted as RFC 2822 for the Date header.
